$comment: Skill-portability rules (F-079, design W4 §5.1) as DATA so two lints share one spelling: wicked-garden's tests/test_skill_portability.py (fails CI) and wicked-crew's publisher validator (packages/crew/src/skills/refs.ts) which imports this file as a parity fixture. Regexes stay in the ECMAScript/Python common subset (fixed-width lookbehind only, no named groups). The corpus at the bottom is the regression set both sides must agree on: `quiet` entries produce no token, each `trips` entry produces exactly its token.

launcher.runtime_block:
## Runtime
Script-backed steps use the `wicked-garden` launcher: `wicked-garden run <plugin-root-relative path, e.g. scripts/…> [args]`. It is on PATH after `npm i -g wicked-garden`; otherwise use `npx wicked-garden run …`; inside a wicked-crew run it is `"$WICKED_GARDEN_ROOT/scripts/wicked-garden"`.
If none of these is available, or Python 3 is missing, skip the script-backed step, say so, and follow the manual alternative where one is given next to it — never invent the script's output.
Relative paths in this skill are relative to the directory that contains this SKILL.md.

fallbacks.fork_worker_sentence: This skill is designed to run as an isolated worker; when your harness cannot fork, run it inline and keep its output separate from the caller's.
fallbacks.dispatch_sentence: Dispatch uses the Skill tool on Claude Code (a fresh forked context). On any other harness, open the named skill's `SKILL.md` from your skills catalog and carry out its instructions inline with the given args, then continue here.

tokens.rule: text contains ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} (garden also fails on the bare identifier CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT anywhere under skills/)

an interpreter (or cd) followed by a relative path that EXISTS in the plugin bundle (scripts/**, skills/**, schemas/**, docs/**, hooks/**) and is not written as a launcher call; a relative path that exists INSIDE the referencing skill's own directory is allowed; matches inside fenced blocks whose language is not a shell carrier (sh|bash|zsh|shell|console|text, unlabeled, or yaml/yml — CI templates carry `run:` shell lines) are ignored
a ../ token whose resolved target exists in the bundle (outside any skill directory: schemas/, docs/, root files)
a ../ token (or a ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/<other> ref) whose resolved target lives in ANOTHER skill's directory — write the skill NAME (wicked-garden-<other>) + its skill-relative file instead

a wicked-garden-<x> name that no SKILL.md declares (template forms — a name containing `{` or followed by `-` as in `wicked-garden-qe-{a, b}` / `wicked-garden-qe-*` / `wicked-garden-<x>` — are skipped)
a skill whose own files use `wicked-garden run|python|path` must carry the exact ## Runtime block in its SKILL.md
a /wicked-garden:<x> slash form in a skill BODY (frontmatter descriptions may keep 'former /wicked-garden:x invocation' trigger phrases) — skills are not slash commands on any CLI
a context: fork SKILL.md must carry the fork_worker_sentence
a file that dispatches with Skill(skill=…) must carry the dispatch_sentence once
a file that mentions AskUserQuestion (outside frontmatter) must also spell the plain-text fallback
frontmatter metadata.requires-harness: claude declared by the author — not a lint; crew reports reasons: ['requires-harness:claude'], portable: false
